title: SDLC Work Item v3
description: An agent-guided intake record with mandatory version-impact guidance for branch-aware delivery.
$comment: JSON Schema validates structure and field types. Host-level validation must additionally enforce work-item ID allocation, branch and baseline state, request digest, requirement ID uniqueness, acceptance-criterion ID uniqueness, path containment, intake-owned write authorization, and the explicit acceptance gate for status=accepted. Optional type, baseline, and source fields support repository coordination metadata without replacing the authoritative structured request and requirements contract. Work-item v3 requires versionSuggestion in every lifecycle state; its impact is an inferred recommendation, not an actual release version, and must be increased when final changes exceed the initial expectation.

schema.description: The exact versioned contract used by this work-item record.

workItemId.description: Stable local or externally originated work-item identifier allocated or confirmed during intake.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the work-item record. Use accepted only after explicit acceptance follows a finalized successful assessment; accepted does not claim implementation or production readiness.

oneOf.description: Use while intake is captured but the work item has not passed or has not yet received explicit acceptance after assessment.

Use after the latest assessment is finalized, has no unresolved blocking or required questions, recommends acceptance, and an authorized operator explicitly accepts the work item. This status permits decomposition or implementation but does not claim that either has completed.
Use after acceptance when decomposition, implementation, or another authorized delivery activity is actively in progress.
Use when progress cannot continue because a material blocker is recorded with an owner or next action.
Use when the requested implementation work is recorded as completed, while final completion or release evidence may still be pending.
Use when implementation changes exist but required validation or evidence is incomplete; do not treat the work as proven or complete.
Use only when the required implementation, validation, and completion evidence has passed and the work item is closed.
Use when an authorized decision explicitly postpones the work item; record the reason and any resumption condition.
